FLUIDLOVEBAND-BAND.title: The Fluid Love Band
FLUIDLOVEBAND-BAND.description: [gold]The Setlist[/gold]: Alex, Toby and Freddie, plus a laptop running the drum track. A country rock folk electric disco band playing their way up the Spire. Every card adds a note; three notes make a Song.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-BAND.goldMonologue: [sine]Petrol money. Maybe a new set of strings.[/sine]
FLUIDLOVEBAND-BAND.eventDeathPrevention: Not yet. We have not played the encore.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-BAND.aromaPrinciple: [sine][blue]Smoke machine, spilt cider, and a warm amp.[/blue][/sine]
